decisive_spans.text: On PET-CT, the mass demonstrated fluorodeoxyglucose avidity with an SUVmax of 5.2

response.rationale: The PET-CT finding of fluorodeoxyglucose avidity strongly supports lymphoma and contradicts abscess and teratoma. While metastasis can also be FDG avid, the normal brain and chest CT scans make metastasis less likely as a primary diagnosis in this context.
